mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of the police, fire services, postal services, extension services and telephone services."
The institutional infrastructure is made up of the police, fire services, postal services, extension services and telephone services.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a non- institutional source of credit and it thrives more in rural areas than institutional sources (Adegeye, et. al. 1985)."
Cooperative savings group is a non- institutional source of credit and it thrives more in rural areas than institutional sources (Adegeye, et. al. 1985).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one whose farming methods and personal attitudes are so superior that his or her operations can serve as a model for others to follow."
A model farmer is the one whose farming methods and personal attitudes are so superior that his or her operations can serve as a model for others to follow.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the earliest general economic activities in the world."
Hunting is one of the earliest general economic activities in the world.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a living condition in which an entity is faced with economic, social, political, cultural and environmental deprivations (Ajakaiye et. al., 1989)."
Poverty is a living condition in which an entity is faced with economic, social, political, cultural and environmental deprivations (Ajakaiye et. al., 1989).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the worship of the "god of iron"."
Ogun worship is the worship of the "god of iron".
fib: ______ are used to describe the quantity of goods and services actually consumed by an individual and his/her family.
Levels of living are used to describe the quantity of goods and services actually consumed by an individual and his/her family.
______ is the total way of life of a people.
Culture is the total way of life of a people.
______ is regarded as large urban if it attracts a population of about 100,000.
A settlement is regarded as large urban if it attracts a population of about 100,000.
______ is the main occupation of rural communities as over seventy percent of the ruralites are engaged in agriculture for survival.
Farming is the main occupation of rural communities as over seventy percent of the ruralites are engaged in agriculture for survival.
______ is the position occupied by an individual in the society.
Social class is the position occupied by an individual in the society.
______ is the cultural aspect of the society which includes the native tools, weapons, machines, ideas, values of the people, customs, folkways, mores and language.
The socio-cultural environment is the cultural aspect of the society which includes the native tools, weapons, machines, ideas, values of the people, customs, folkways, mores and language.
